study.question: Does the near-reference utility of the compact fine-context representation require target-local fine recency or observed category-brand pair-concentration statistics, or can empirical conditional-marginal summaries retain utility with less measured computation?
study.hypothesis: Local observation: fine_context attained 0.6200897204 AUC versus 0.6204259428 for joint_identity, with training 430.51s versus 548.36s. Fine versus coarse improved AUC by +0.0004548056 without pooled content and +0.0005360149 with it, while content effects were -0.0001231922 at fine age and -0.0002044015 at coarse age. This motivates testing the necessity of the retained relationships, not adding event embeddings. Provisional hypothesis: some fine-age utility reflects global freshness conditional on coarse recency rather than detailed match-group localization, and some pair-concentration utility can be represented by its field marginals. The combined analytic replacements may retain this compact representation at the same active capacity while avoiding one sort and reducing temporal group scatters. Competing hypothesis: at least one discarded dependency is useful and causes a selective, repeated quality loss. Neither direction is assumed true.

nearest_work.difference: Inherits static embedding/MLP and the question of target-dependent history representation, but uses fixed target-match histograms and empirical products rather than per-event learned local activation. The source uses unnormalized activation weights; our existing baseline-din uses softmax and category/brand/action/age fields, so it is an adapted reference, not an exact reproduction. No claim that conditional independence or pooling is new.

Only the author field warning is verified: history has category/brand/behavior and no item identity. The proposal respects that boundary and does not claim to implement DMR relevance objectives; full paper access remains unavailable.

Direct parent is the compact first-order count-projection implementation. local_joint is a forward-equivalent reproduction control with the same parameter allocation; new candidates replace conditional fine-age information and/or observed joint concentration without changing active capacity, training, or coarse tables.

Retains fixed match-group scalar lineage but omits its event content means, independent content-context moments and global norm readout as in the compact parent. Previous partial brand-folding costs -0.0003086415 for this reference and +0.0000464973 for compact_matched; those weak mixed contrasts do not establish pairing necessity.

study.proposed_difference: A controlled 2x2 conditional-marginal replacement, not another capacity or embedding-content restoration study. Temporal factorization preserves N[group,coarse_age] and N[coarse_age,fine_age] within each impression while removing the residual group/fine-age association conditional on coarse age. Explicit coarse/fine joint counts avoid incorrect handling of bins straddling 3600,86400,604800 seconds. Identity factorization uses the analytic entropy/collision of the product of empirical field marginals on shared support and skips the unused joint sort in trained forward. This isolates readout relationships only; target category-brand matching and coarse action-age association remain visible. Novelty beyond a local empirical sufficiency study is unverified.
predictions: Implementation: local_joint has the parent parameter order/shapes and forward function up to floating-point noise; no population AUC deviation larger than 0.0001 is expected for the identical seed. A larger difference triggers source/execution investigation before mechanism interpretation.

Temporal replacement preserves group masses, per-group coarse-age counts, global fine-age counts, and global coarse/fine counts; it can change group-local fine recency while leaving coarse action-age and identity features invariant on the supplied witness.

Identity replacement preserves common marginal summaries and changes only the two pair-concentration coordinates per group; diagnostics fast and full selected outputs agree. The pair-collision witness has entropy gap log(2) and collision gap 0.25, with all nonidentity features fixed.

If the sufficiency hypothesis holds, at least one replacement will have candidate minus local_joint AUC >= -0.0002 and candidate minus full joint_identity AUC >= -0.0005 in screening; utility retention requires paired-seed repetition and a paired user-cluster uncertainty interval when authorized predictions are available. Margins are prospective engineering screening choices made after seeing prior results, not evidence of formal noninferiority or business tolerances.

Cost: product mode executes two identity sorts rather than three; actual training time may drop but is not inferred from this operation count. A candidate enters the efficiency frontier only with measured cost reduction: target at least 15% training-time reduction relative to full joint_identity while meeting the stated quality screen; report inference separately because prior compact inference showed little gain.

Compute AUC and Logloss contrasts within both levels of the other factor; an interaction weakens a simple additive necessity explanation. Logloss improvements or regressions are reported even when AUC is primary.
falsifiers: Any source/interface, count-margin, scalar-statistic, padding, empty-history or finite-logit failure invalidates the implementation; it is not scientific counterevidence until corrected and cost remains charged.

A repeatable AUC deficit larger than the stated screen after localization replacement rejects global-conditional sufficiency for this implementation; it does not prove all target dependence or all compression necessary.
A repeatable deficit after product replacement with nonzero statistic differences rejects this marginal readout replacement, but does not prove every category-brand relationship is necessary.
No measured training/inference improvement at comparable quality rejects an efficiency claim, even if a sort was removed.

One null seed, negligible intervention magnitude, a near-zero trained identity head, or a confidence interval crossing the retention boundary cannot establish sufficiency. A large factor interaction precludes an additive mechanism explanation.

Analytic empirical products include self combinations and fractional expected counts; they are not random shuffles or derangements
Removing a statistic also changes its numerical geometry and redundancy; same capacity alone cannot distinguish useful information from easier optimization

The full reference may help through omitted moments/global norms or a different optimization geometry; this study does not separately attribute that remaining reference gap.
Sparse group/complete-support coverage may cause null effects; diagnostics are from 512 rows and do not establish population prevalence.
Most validation impressions have long histories and repeated users; row independence would understate uncertainty.
The supplied baseline and compact results use one seed and repeated validation selection; additional seeds on the same validation day do not resolve temporal generalization.
